dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Rana loves Starshrooms! If only I could get some from the forest...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Rana is amazing, and I want to be just like her when I grow up, a Forest Watcher who adventures in the forest!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Aranara...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I don't know... Sorry, but I really can't tell you...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the story of the dragon...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: How do I become friends with a dragon? It would be amazing to befriend one!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Oh, see you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Sorry! I'll stay out of the forest from now on, Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Rana is like this because of me...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'll do my best to help her.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Please, {NICKNAME}...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: She'll get better...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: R—Really?

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #By the way, {NICKNAME}, can you keep everything from Sudabeh and Kavus? I don't want them to get worried too.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: They'll sneak out and go after Rana if they find out... But the forest is very dangerous right now...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I promise.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. Please, please save Rana... *sob*

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Thank goodness Rana is alright! But why did she suddenly go traveling? I want to go traveling too...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rana...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}. It's all thanks to you that Rana wakes up again...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'll be a good boy for grandma, the village chief, and Rana, from now on. I won't try to explore the dangerous places in the forest.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'll grow up to be a great man, and go look for Rana and Arana!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Alphonso...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: It's been quite a while since I've seen Alphonso...

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: Rana and Alphonso must have left because they have something very important to do.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: I'll eat well and sleep well. When I grow up, it'll be my turn to invite them to play!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Oh, see you, {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Keep it up, Iotham.

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}! I want to be a great person just like you, and help those in need just as Rana and you did for me!

dialogues.speaker: Iotham
dialogues.text: #Right, take these Starshrooms, {NICKNAME}. Rana says eating the Starshrooms I picked always lifts her spirits. I hope they can lift your spirits, too!
